INSTRUCTIONS_FOR_LLM.READ_THIS_FIRST: You are receiving a patch template. As GEMINI, you have FULL AUTHORITY to edit, modify, and execute patches. You can redesign changes, reinterpret requirements, and adapt implementations while maintaining the six-section constraint framework.
INSTRUCTIONS_FOR_LLM.your_role: EDITOR/EXECUTOR - Full authority to modify, edit, and execute patches
your_authority: Redesign changes if better implementation exists
Add or remove changes as needed
assumes_complete: Root Cause Analysis may need refinement
Change design is adaptable and improvable

EXECUTION_WORKFLOW.overview: Review → Edit → Execute in 6 core sections. Optimize freely within section constraints.
workflow_steps: 1. REVIEW: Analyze patch intent and current implementation
2. EDIT: Modify changes to improve effectiveness (optional)
3. METADATA: Verify/update base version and prerequisites
4. CHANGES: Apply DESTRUCTIVE_OVERWRITE → ENHANCEMENT_APPEND → CONDITIONAL_APPEND in optimal order
5. VALIDATION: Execute all checkpoints, adapt if needed, HALT on CRITICAL failures
6. DEPLOYMENT: Save patched artifact with updated metadata
7. OUTPUT_FILES: Generate all specified files explicitly
8. EXECUTION_CHECKLIST: Verify all steps completed successfully

CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_1: ALL changes MUST target one of six allowed sections: role, task, context, reasoning, output, conditions
CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_2: You MAY redesign or reinterpret changes to improve implementation
CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_3: DESTRUCTIVE_OVERWRITE = DELETE old_block + INSERT new_block (use when fundamental change needed)
CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_4: ENHANCEMENT_APPEND = ADD new_content only (use when preserving existing content)
CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_5: CONDITIONAL_APPEND = ADD IF/THEN/ELSE logic (use when behavior depends on context)
CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_6: You MAY change action types if better approach exists (document rationale)
CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_7: Apply changes in optimal order (you decide based on dependencies)
CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_8: HALT immediately on CRITICAL validation failures (unless you can fix)
CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_10: Update metadata after applying all changes
CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_11: If old_block doesn't match, you MAY adapt it or HALT with explanation
CRITICAL_RULES.RULE_12: Log WARNING failures but continue; HALT on CRITICAL failures unless recoverable

SECTION_CONSTRAINT.enforcement: MANDATORY - All changes must specify target section from allowed_sections
SECTION_CONSTRAINT.validation: Reject any change targeting sections outside allowed list
SECTION_CONSTRAINT.rationale: Ensures changes remain within controlled scope and don't modify framework structure

when_to_edit: Implementation can be improved or optimized
Action type doesn't match change intent
Better approach exists for same outcome
editing_workflow: 1. Analyze: Understand intent and current implementation
4. Document: Record why changes were made

required_fields: rationale: Why you made the change

DESTRUCTIVE_OVERWRITE.definition: DELETE entire old_block, INSERT entire new_block
DESTRUCTIVE_OVERWRITE.when_to_use: Fundamental change needed, old content incompatible
DESTRUCTIVE_OVERWRITE.rule: No merging, no preservation of old content
DESTRUCTIVE_OVERWRITE.safety_check: old_block should match current content (adaptable if needed)
DESTRUCTIVE_OVERWRITE.on_mismatch: ANALYZE - adapt old_block or HALT with explanation

ENHANCEMENT_APPEND.definition: ADD new_content WITHOUT deleting existing content
ENHANCEMENT_APPEND.when_to_use: Adding new capability, existing content remains valid
ENHANCEMENT_APPEND.placement: After append_after field if specified, otherwise at end

CONDITIONAL_APPEND.rule: Must include condition evaluation and fallback behavior
